judgments.rationale: The source passage specifies that the requirement to send a written notice applies 'unless the following information is contained in the initial communication or the consumer has paid the debt.' The proposed modification changes this disjunctive exception into a conjunctive condition ('unless both the information is contained in the initial communication and the consumer has paid the debt'), which contradicts the source by improperly narrowing the exception and requiring both conditions to be met before the debt collector is excused from sending the notice.
